snippet.title: Beastro | Release Date Reveal Trailer (June 11th)
snippet.description:
Not all heroes wield swords… some prefer the spoon!

Beastro launches on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S (with day one availability on Gamepass) on June 11th, 2026

In Beastro, the key to saving the world is a really good meal. Play as Panko, a young and talented chef whose teacher goes missing, leaving him to step up and take over the restaurant. Serve the Caretakers, brave adventurers sent to save the world, and watch your meals energise them and shape the turn-based, deckbuilding combat they recount to you each evening.

Craft thoughtful meals, balance flavor profiles, sharpen your skills, and unlock a plethora of abilities...

Because who can save the world on an empty stomach?

Wishlist today!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2417470/Beastro
